articles.title: Install Torve
articles.answer: Get Android phone and Google TV / Android TV builds from Google Play. Fire TV and Windows have official downloads on the Torve download page. Use the current links and file checksums there; do not rely on version numbers from chat.

articles.title: Fire TV installation
articles.answer: On compatible Android-based Fire OS devices, install Downloader by AFTVnews from the Amazon Appstore. In Downloader, open torve.app/firetv and use the official APK button. Follow the device-specific install-permission steps on that page. Vega OS devices do not support this APK method. If Downloader is missing from the permission list, check Fire TV updates, restart, and contact support with the device model and OS version if it is still missing.

articles.title: Bring your own media
articles.answer: Torve does not supply media, playlists, subscriptions, or viewing rights. Connect only services and media you are authorized to access. For connection-specific instructions, open the Torve guide after signing in. Do not post provider credentials, playlist URLs, or API keys in Discord.

articles.title: Account and sync
articles.answer: Sign in to use sync, device linking, account-backed watch state, preferences, exports, and account deletion. These features are tied to your Torve account. Use the official sign-in and support pages for account help; the Discord bot cannot access or change your account.

articles.title: Apple availability
articles.answer: At the 25 October 2026 documentation review, public iPhone, iPad and Apple TV releases were listed as in preparation. Check the live download page for current availability and the terms page for Apple Premium details.

articles.title: Contact the Torve team
articles.answer: Reach the team at support@torve.app. For a bug, include what happened, steps to reproduce, your platform, app version, and expected result. Leave out credentials and private data. Account, export, deletion and security matters should use the private support route. Public bug reports can use the issue tracker linked from the Torve support page.
